build_simple_uvit_model: build a SimpleUViT vision transformer model for image classification with configurable depth and patch size
create_attention_module: create an Attention module with multi-head self-attention using query-key-value projections and softmax
create_transformer_blocks: create a Transformer block with skip connections that concatenates features from the first half of layers
test_simple_uvit_forward_pass: test SimpleUViT forward pass on a batch of images and verify output shape matches number of classes
create_sincos_position_embedding: create 2D sine-cosine positional embeddings for a grid of height and width with given feature dimension
